column2: Accessibly PDF document is required to contain AltText or ActualText for figures. AltText label(to describe the appearance) and ActualText can provide figures with meaningful descriptions for accessibility. column3: 替代文本（AltText）与插图所需的实际文本（ActualText）是可访问PDF所必需的。通过利用替代文本（AltText）标签（用于描述外观）和实际文本（ActualText）标签，插图将具有某种形式的有意义的说明以用于辅助工具。替代文本（AltText）标签不能自动生成，而必须由作者手动进行添加。您可使用“标签”面板来添加替代文本。

column2: Artifact (page content that are not to be read or reflowed) may be misidentified when pagination or layout subtypes are thought to be recognized. In the case of pagination artifacts, text (often a single number) sits far out and away from other text regions. Layout artifacts occurs from a variety of areas including horizontal lines thought to be separators and also images, xform, and boxes serving as backgrounds for the text on top of or inside these items. Corrections are usually made by changing the text back to a paragraph or graphics to be part of a figure.
column3: 当分页或者版面子类型被视为可识别的情况下，伪像（无法被阅读或者重排的页面内容）可能会被错误识别。对于分页的伪像，文本（通常是一个数字）会远离其它的文本区域。版面伪像会出现自多种区域，包括被视为分隔符的水平线，以及在文本上或者文本中作为背景的图像，扩展表单和方框等。更正的方法通常是将文本移回段落，或将图形设为插图的一部分。

column2: Auto Tagging of figures might have issues because figures that consists of texts, lines and images might not always have easily recognizable boundaries. When identifying figures, it is common to run into problems of including partial or extra elements.   Recognize multiple figures as one, or one as many are also common problems.  Correction involves manually identify and group all of the required element into one structural figure element.  You can also add actual text, alternate text, expansion text or titles on the identified figure.
column3: 插图的自动标签可能存在问题，因为插图可能由文本，线条和图像构成，它们可能缺少一些可容易被识别到的边界。当识别插图时，出现只包含了部分或者多了额外元素的情况是很常见的。将多个插图识别成一个，或者将一个识别成多个同样也是常见问题。更正方法是手动识别并组合所有必需的元素到一个结构化的插图元素中。识别插图元素后，您也可以添加实际文本，替代文本，扩展文本或者标题。

column2: A list item defines an element which is part of list. A list item is often not recognized due to a limited number of elements in the list or having most other list items appear on a different page. List items include an optional label and a body.  Correction involves grouping the list item and its label and body properly. This can only be done in the Tags Panel.
column3: 列表项目定义了列表的构成元素。一个列表条目无法识别，通常是由于列表中的元素太少或者多数其它列表项目显示在别的页面上。列表项目包含一个可选的标签和正文。更正方法是正确组合列表项目和其标签/正文。该操作仅可以在“标签”面板中完成。

column2: A paragraph is the basic building block of text. Identification problems may occur due to unique or inconsistent formatting. Also, very short one-line paragraphs can also be confused with negative indent formatting such as that found in dictionaries or lists. Correction usually involves grouping the correct text lines together to form the paragraph. Sometimes incorrect region analysis will lead to two columns of text falsely being grouped as a single region. This will lead to poor paragraph recognition due to the text lines running across boundaries.
column3: 段落是文本的基本构建块。独特或不一致的段落格式可能导致识别出错。此外，过短的单行段落可能会与字典或者列表中的负值缩进格式相混淆。更正的方法通常是将正确的文本行组合成段落。有时，不正确的区域分析会导致两列文本被错误的组合为一个区域。这将导致段落识别出错，因为文本行可能超出了边界。

column2: Add Tags starts by dividing a page into regions of contiguous content. Regions are sometimes combined or split. This is most often caused by side-by-side regions with very small spacing between columns or very irregular alignment of the left edge of a column of text. Other possible causes include background or graphical objects under or near the text in the region. Although regions do not show up directly as structural elements, failure to properly recognize  their boundaries will usually lead to poor recognition of structure.
column3: “添加标签”会先将页面划分为若干个包含连续内容的区域。区域有时会被合并或者分割，这通常是由于相邻区域的列间距过小或者文字列使用了非常规的左对齐方式。此外，区域内位于文字下方或者旁边的背景以及图形对象也会导致此类状况的发生。尽管区域不会直接显示为结构元素，但无法正确识别其边界将导致结果难以识别。

column2: The table header is a table cell which contains information used as an identifier to other cells within the table. Whitespace tables sometimes result in text lines assigned to the wrong rows. Two or more neighboring cells may be inadvertently combined or a single cell may be inadvertently split into two or more cells. Header cells may be confused with data cells; this is especially true with complex tables. To correct a table header cell, use the Tags Panel to group the text and graphics belonging to that cell and be sure to set the appropriate row and column spans. The Touch Up Reading Order Tool can be used for some cell split corrections.
column3: 标题单元格是一个表单元格，其包含可供其它单元格识别的标识符。空白表格有时会导致文本行被指定到错误的表行中。2个或者多个相邻的单元格可能会被意外的合并，或是一个单元格可能被意外的分割为2个或多个单元格。标题单元格也可能会与数据单元格混淆；这种情况通常出现在复杂的单元格中，要更正标题单元格，请使用“标签”面板将属于该单元格的文本和图形组合起来，并确保设置正确的行列跨距。您还可以使用“Touch Up阅读顺序”工具来更正某些单元格的分割问题。

column2: The table row is a horizontal unit within the table. Rows might be incorrectly split so that two lines of text each have their own row when they should be on a single row. A table row tag should have only table ( data or header ) cells as children. It may be necessary to regroup the text together to form the cells in a row. When creating row tags using the Tags Panel, it is easier to define a row, then define each individual cell along with its row and column span. Another technique using the Tags Panel is to move cells that are already defined to the correct rows.
column3: 表行是表格中的水平单元。表行可能会被错误的分割，使得本应该在同一表行上的两行文本被分别放置到两个表行上。表行标签应该仅包含作为子元素的表（数据或者表头）单元格。有时可能需要重新组合文本来将单元格组成表行。当使用“标签”面板创建行标签时，比较容易的做法是先定义行，然后按照先行后列的顺序定义各个单元格。另一种方法是使用“标签”面板，将已定义的单元格移动到正确的表行。

column2: The table represents information organized by rows and cells within rows. Tables may or may not contain borders. Known as whitespace tables, table without borders between cells are difficult to identify correctly. Occasionally, rows or columns of whitespace tables are left out and/or neighboring text may be included. Lists may also be mistaken for tables. To correctly specify a table, rows must be the children of that table (and cells must be properly specified within that row). Table tagging can be updated using the Tags Panel and Touch Up Reading Order tool.
column3: 表通过行和列中的单元格来组织要表现的信息。表格可包含边框，也可以不包含。但单元格之间没有边框的空白表格将难以进行识别。偶尔，空白表的行或列可能包括遗漏或者邻近的文本。而列表可能会被错误的识别为表。要正确的指定表，行必须是表的子元素（且必须在行中正确指定单元格）可以使用“标签”面板和“Touch Up阅读顺序”工具来更新表标签。

column2: Table of contents items are defined as individual items comprising a table of contents. Occasionally these are either falsely identified or not identified. This is more likely in case of a partial table of contents or in those cases of multi-column table of contents. Correction will involve creating table of contents items and placing this list under a single table of content structural element. Each table of contents item should have an optional label or number, a title, an optional leader, and  typically a page reference or number. Use the Tags Panel to create this tag structure.
column3: 目录项就是组成目录的各个项目。其偶尔会被错误识别或者无法进行识别。这通常发生在多行目录的情况下。更正方法是创建目录项目并将该列表放置在单独的目录结构元素下。每个目录项目应该包含一个可选的标签或编号，标题，可选的引线以及页面引用或者页码。请使用“标签”面板来创建标签结构。
